This '''[[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior''' was a member of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he and a [[Unidentified Death Watch Mandalorian 2|fellow Mandalorian]] guarded the [[Death Watch hideout]] on [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]]. They attacked and captured [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who inspected an abandoned [[Mining/Legends|mining]] facility. Both warriors were later knocked unconscious by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].

Later he, along with two other Mandalorians, accompanied [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] and watched as he had a lightsaber duel with Obi-Wan Kenobi. When Vizsla was bested, he ordered the three Mandalorians to finish the Jedi off. They then activated their jet pack missiles and fired them upon Kenobi and the Duchess. Kenobi and the Duchess escaped by jumping down the elevator shaft and the missiles hit the wall.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Mandalorian was voiced by [[Corey Burton]], who also voiced [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] and [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' TV series]].
